column3: Punishment for murder
column4: Imprisonment for life or death penalty.

column3: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
column4: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

column3: Attempt to murder
column4: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

column3: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
column4: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Punishment for rape
column4: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

column3: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
column4: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine.

column3: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
column4: Imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine.

column3: Punishment for criminal intimidation
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Unnatural offences
column4: Imprisonment up to life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine.

column3: Mischief causing damage to the amount of fifty rupees
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Adultery
column4: Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Sexual harassment and punishment for sexual harassment
column4: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Theft in dwelling house, etc.
column4: Imprisonment up to 7 years, and fine.

column3: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
column4: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment
column4: Punishment as per the original offense.

column3: Joining unlawful assembly armed with deadly weapon
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

column3: Joining or continuing in unlawful assembly, knowing it has been commanded to disperse
column4: Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine, or both.

column3: Punishment for criminal intimidation by an anonymous communication
column4: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.
